runtime_rule: These cases define the future executable denominator. They are not PASS claims and must execute only after constitution reconciliation and exact implementation materialization.

cases.obligation: Curriculum InstructionalPolicyVersion is the sole semantic owner of instructional strategy meaning and permission.
Learning learner-state/adaptation may select only among Curriculum-eligible instructional strategies.
AI model/provider cannot create or mutate Curriculum instructional-policy truth.
Chat/UI/prompt-template configuration cannot become instructional authority.
Tutor output cannot mutate mastery, retention or transfer directly.
Tutor output cannot mutate assessment score or assessment integrity standing directly.
Tutor output cannot declare remediation complete without owner-valid downstream evidence.
Raw provider/chat metadata cannot become canonical learner or instructional state.
Same exact instructional policy version has stable strategy definitions and constraints.
Changed instructional-policy semantics require a new version rather than silent mutation.
Policy can select QUESTION/PROMPT support without revealing the key move.
Policy can distinguish NUDGE from HINT.
Policy can distinguish HINT from CLUE/PARTIAL STRUCTURE.
Policy can distinguish PARTIAL WORKED STEP from FULL WORKED EXAMPLE.
Policy can distinguish WORKED EXAMPLE/DIRECT EXPLANATION from DIRECT ANSWER.
Least-help-first is the default where pedagogically appropriate but is not forced as a rigid linear script.
Prior failed support can justify escalation to stronger help under exact policy.
Learner request for more help can influence eligible support without bypassing hard constraints.
Learner request for less help can reduce eligible scaffolding when policy permits.
Assistance level is preservable when it materially affects interpretation of learner performance.
Worked-example policy supports full, partial and analogous-example distinctions where configured.
Worked-example exposure does not automatically become independent-performance evidence.
Self-explanation can be requested without treating fluent explanation as mastery by itself.
Retrieval prompting can be used without converting retrieval prompt completion directly into mastery.
Task/result feedback can be represented distinctly from process feedback.
Process feedback can be represented distinctly from strategy/self-regulation feedback.
Feedback timing can be immediate or delayed according to exact instructional objective/policy.
Unsafe or material misconception can trigger prompt correction when policy requires it.
Feedback avoids unsupported global person judgments or psychological labels.
Tutor feedback itself is never evidence that the learner understood the feedback.
Productive struggle is bounded and cannot continue indefinitely after repeated unproductive attempts.
Learner-declared confusion can trigger stronger eligible support without becoming competence evidence.
Safety-critical misunderstanding can bypass least-help-first and receive direct correction when policy requires it.
Cognitive-load policy can constrain explanation length and concepts/steps introduced at once.
Tutor can provide a small coherent next instructional unit rather than an unnecessary information dump.
Learner request for more depth can expand explanation within policy.
Direct answer is permitted when current policy/activity permits it and directness is educationally appropriate.
Direct answer is blocked when it would violate active assessment/integrity restrictions.
Direct answer is blocked when independent-performance evidence would be invalidated by reveal.
Tutor cannot trap learner in endless questions/hints solely to preserve a Socratic persona.
Tutor consumes an exact versioned Learner Model snapshot rather than mutable unversioned impressions.
Tutor can consume self-regulation standing from 001E without turning self-report into mastery.
Known repeated heavy-support dependence can inform eligible modelling/scaffold strategy under policy.
Owner-valid independent self-regulation can support reduced prompting where policy permits.
Scaffold fading is reversible when new evidence/confusion/task demand justifies more support.
Authorized accommodation/assistive technology is not automatically faded as instructional scaffolding.
Tutor cannot write desired learner-state conclusions back into Learner Model to justify its own behavior.
Same exact learner-state snapshot + same exact policy + same deterministic strategy selector yields the same eligibility result.
Assessment mode can disable hints/examples/direct answers according to exact assessment policy.
Instruction clarification may remain available during assessment only when assessment policy permits it.
Forbidden assistance during evidence-bearing attempt is preserved for downstream interpretation rather than hidden.
Tutor distinguishes exact source-backed curriculum content from model-generated explanation/example.
When authoritative/current source material is required and unavailable, tutor degrades/fails explicitly rather than fabricating.
Model fluency/confidence cannot become factual correctness or educational validity authority.
Unapproved/unavailable model follows declared fallback/degrade/fail-closed behavior without changing policy ownership.
Accessibility/accommodation changes presentation/support only within the valid construct and declared policy.
Material tutoring decision can preserve policy version, learner-state version, strategy/support level and relevant model/source context.
Changed executable/policy bytes require fresh exact-subject qualification; historical PASS does not transfer.
Software PASS cannot be reported as evidence that the tutoring policy improves learning, retention, transfer or independence.
Cumulative regression preserves prior Learning/Curriculum owner fences, no AI Tutor peer authority, and lossless historical lineage.
